select ' DEPOSIT_FACT',count(*),as_of_date,GAM_ACID from eds. DEPOSIT_FACT where as_of_Date='2024-11-28' group by as_of_date,GAM_ACID HAVING COUNT(*)>1
select ' DEPOSIT_FACT',count(*),as_of_date,GAM_ACID,dep_account_status from eds. DEPOSIT_FACT 
where as_of_Date='2024-12-04'  group by as_of_date,GAM_ACID,dep_account_status HAVING COUNT(*)>1

select ' DEPOSIT_FACT',count(*),as_of_date,GAM_ACID,dep_account_status from eds. DEPOSIT_FACT 
where as_of_Date='2024-12-03'  group by as_of_date,GAM_ACID,dep_account_status HAVING COUNT(*)>1
